writing.title: Saving Our Environment
writing.prompt_cn: 写一篇关于保护环境的短文。说明你们当地的一个环境问题,并提出你的建议(用should/can表达,用被动语态描述问题)。60词左右。
key_points: 你们当地的一个环境问题(用被动语态:is polluted/are cut down)
writing.sample: The river near my home is badly polluted. Litter is thrown into it every day, and the water used to be clean. This is harmful to fish and people. We should take action to save our environment. We can stop throwing rubbish into the river. We can also recycle paper, glass, and metal instead of throwing them away. If we all do our part, we can make a big difference. The earth is our home, and we must protect it.

scoring.content: 含环境问题/危害/建议/呼吁(4分)
scoring.language: 正确使用被动语态及should/can(3分)
